summary: Connect an information system to government integration services.

steps.title: Choose an integration service
steps.detail: Find the service owner, specification, and connection requirements. Verify that your role can access the service.

steps.title: Prepare the connection request
steps.detail: Confirm the test environment, network setup, organization, and certificate with the operator.

steps.title: Identify how to receive a response
steps.detail: Check whether responses are synchronous or asynchronous. Agree on a delivery endpoint for asynchronous responses.
